name: colophon
description: Declares AI co-authorship with the Colophon sigil, a link at the end of comments, tickets and messages the AI has substantially co-written — it names the model, what it contributed, and whether a human approved it. Covers GitHub, Jira, Slack and Trello, plus an HTML anchor for mail and wiki pages; the link is generated by the bundled script, never reconstructed by hand.
